title: 10 × 10 Graphics and Maze Experiments
description: 4 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Maze generator, W=127 L=47 (descriptive identification)
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines; consistent pointer base 17125; exact full length and end marker; byte-identical left/right recovery
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
2 CLS
3 W=127:L=47
4 MB=10
5 DEFINT C:DIM C(1,MB)
10 T=RND(MB/3):B=RND(MB/3):MP=RND(MB/3):IFINT(MB/9*2)<>0THENLL=RND(MB/9*2):R=RND(MB/9*2)
15 FORAA=0TOW:SET(AA,0):SET(AA,L):NEXTAA:FORAA=0TOL:SET(0,AA):SET(W,AA):NEXTAA
20 E=T+B+LL+R+MP
22 IF E>MB THEN GOSUB 6000:GOTO 20
25 FOR AA=1TO4:FORBB=0TO1:READ H(BB,AA):NEXTBB,AA
26 DATA 1,0,-1,0,0,1,0,-1
30 FOR TC=1TOT:C(0,TC)=RND(W-1):C(1,TC)=1:NEXT TC
35 FQ=6
